sourceSentences: The snowball explodes upon hitting an enemy champion, large pet, medium or large monster, or terrain, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies
If the snowball exploded while it was being steered, Willump becomes stunned
Nunu and Willump keep all increases in movement speed at time of cast for the duration of the charge.
After 3 seconds from the first cast, Snowbound enemies near Willump take magic damage and are rooted
Absolute Zero can be recast after 0.5 seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends by any means.
Nunu and Willump cause the blizzard to explode, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies
The affected area is hidden if the duo is not visible to the enemy team.
The heal is increased while he is below 50% maximum health.
Icon border glows when he is within the maximum healing threshold.
they and a nearby allied champion gain Call of the Freljord for 4 seconds, prioritizing the ally with highest attack speed.
However, if Nunu's still holding the snowball when he makes impact, he will also be very briefly stunned.
Nunu can recast this ability twice more and after 3 seconds, enemies around him take damage and are rooted.
For combos, start with W and just before it lands, reactivate W into your E, attack into your second E, and then Q before using a final E and attack away using alt if sensible.
Entering late game team fights, you either want to lure enemies into your ultimate while you're in a brush or play the engage with a snowball.
vous pouvez tuer n'importe quelle cible fragile en un combo si vous placez votre boule de neige et votre ultime.
car si vous lancez une boule de neige avec le bonus de vitesse, il persiste toute la durée.
Si vous lancez votre boule de neige sur un carapateur, elle a plus de chances de toucher
Cependant, soyez prudent, car tout contrôle de foule de la part du jungler adverse peut interrompre votre ultime.
